purpose: Map normalized environmental and operational records into controlled DMRV evidence classes without upgrading unsupported claims.

evidence_classes.REPORTABLE: Source, timestamp, unit, spatial identity, provenance and quality checks pass.
evidence_classes.MEASURED: A physical measurement or explicitly identified measurement feed exists; method and instrument/source are recorded.
evidence_classes.MODELED: Value is produced by a model or forecast and remains semantically distinct from measurement.
evidence_classes.VALIDATED: Defined validation procedure has passed and supporting evidence is retained.
evidence_classes.VERIFIED: Authorized independent or second-party review has passed the applicable verification procedure.
evidence_classes.ANCHORED: Deterministic evidence package has been cryptographically anchored; this does not prove environmental truth.
evidence_classes.RELEASED: Applicable operational, QMS and regulatory/product-release gates have passed.

package_rules.canonicalization: Deterministic field ordering, explicit units and normalized timestamps.
package_rules.anchor: Only package root/hash is eligible for blockchain anchoring.
package_rules.immutability: Corrections create successor records; historical evidence is not overwritten.

promotion_rules: REPORTABLE requires complete provenance and quality checks.
MEASURED cannot be assigned to forecasts or model outputs.
VALIDATED requires a defined validation method and retained evidence.
VERIFIED requires an authorized review procedure.
RELEASED requires all applicable physical, QMS, regulatory and governance gates.
